========================
EXECUTION DESCRIPTION
========================

To run the project do the following:

1. Set an enviroment variable named WORKSPACE in this way:

set WORKSPACE=YOUR-HOME-DIRECTORY/datos_ensembl/

2. Copy the datos_ensembl folder in the project's tree to your home directory

3. Execute the command java -jar bioinformants.jar <bp upstream> <mRNA|CDS> as described below

java -jar bioinformants.jar predictor.Data 1000 mRNA

or

java -jar bioinformants.jar predictor.Data 100 CDS

4. The datos_ensembl folder will include some new diectories and files, like 3-187668812-187670494.txt below
with an example register of the kind of data used later on to train machine learning models.
